list.name: sensor_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sensor_id FROM window_results ORDER BY sensor_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (sensor_id) sensor_id AS "Sensor", label AS "Latest label", window_start AS "Last seen", round(ellipse_index::numeric, 3) AS "Ellipse index" FROM window_results ORDER BY sensor_id, window_start DESC

panels.title: All sensors -- stiction rate, selected time range (FR-10)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sensor_id AS "Sensor", count(*) FILTER (WHERE label = 'yes') AS "Stiction windows", count(*) FILTER (WHERE label = 'no') AS "Healthy windows", count(*) FILTER (WHERE label = 'uncertain') AS "Uncertain windows" FROM window_results WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY sensor_id ORDER BY sensor_id

SELECT window_start + (idx - 1) * interval '100 milliseconds' AS time, pv_val AS "PV", op_val AS "OP" FROM window_results, unnest(pv, op) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(pv_val, op_val, idx) WHERE sensor_id = '$sensor_id' ORDER BY time
SELECT window_start AS time, label AS "Stiction" FROM window_results WHERE sensor_id = '$sensor_id' ORDER BY time
SELECT window_start AS time, ellipse_index AS "ellipse_index", CASE WHEN kano_verdict THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS "kano_verdict" FROM window_results WHERE sensor_id = '$sensor_id' ORDER BY time
